algorithm: Random Forest Regressor (Tuned with TimeSeriesSplit CV)
dataset_source: Food waste dataset: secondary school in Finland 2024-2025 (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20825233)
model_analysis_notes: Random Forest Regressor was tuned using RandomizedSearchCV over 30 candidate configurations and time-aware TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation. On this 155-sample institutional dining dataset, food wastage behaves according to physical additive mass conservation (batch food prepared vs. diners). While Random Forest captures non-linear splits on training data (Train R² = 0.8594), its decision tree partitions cannot extrapolate smoothly into the chronologically later spring semester test period (Test MAE = 3.88 kg, Test R² = -0.04). In contrast, Ridge Regression's continuous linear regularization generalizes with Test MAE = 2.33 kg and Test R² = 0.64. Per the project guidelines, Random Forest is trained, evaluated, serialized as wastage_model_rf_v2.joblib, and integrated into the dashboard alongside its complete feature importance breakdown.
model_selection_status: Production Active: v2.0.0 (Preserved). Candidate v3.0.0-exp evaluated on expanded dataset (N=215) and retained for benchmarks.

dataset_expansion.scientific_findings: Empirical evaluation shows that adding 60 real-world records from 4 Latvian public schools expands the dataset to N=215. However, because Latvian schools operate at a smaller daily capacity (mean: 285 diners, 85 kg served) compared to the Finnish secondary school (mean: 398 diners, 187 kg served), Random Forest's axis-aligned decision trees create partition boundaries that dilute out-of-sample predictions on the spring holdout test set (Holdout MAE: 4.53 kg, R²: -0.30 vs. v2's MAE: 3.88 kg, R²: -0.04). Cross-institution transfer evaluation confirmed domain shift (Finland->Latvia R²: -0.74; Latvia->Finland R²: -0.00). Per the scientific guidelines, Random Forest v2.0.0 is retained as the active production model to ensure operational reliability, while candidate v3 is preserved as an experimental benchmark.
